subject: [PATCH v6 16/19] selftests/mm: add khugepaged race harness

2026-09-19.patch_summary: This patch adds a selftest harness to exercise khugepaged under contention by simulating various concurrent operations such as faults, GUP pins, fork, mremap, and MADV_DONTNEED on the same address space. The test runs in different modes, including stepped, free, and madvise, each with its own protocol for collapsing pages. The harness checks that a racing page reads either as its original pattern or as zero, ensuring that no other value is read. This selftest aims to identify potential issues related to khugepaged's behavior under concurrent access.
